message:
26 WC adjuster openings at once means case volume is climbing fast. The record review stage tends to break first when that happens.

Brighterway handles the full pipeline: organizes and deduplicates records, filters out 80% of irrelevant pages, generates AI summaries, and gives adjusters a searchable view by body part or document type. Less manual work per claim.

Is that something Intercare is looking to fix?
signal_referenced: 26 active workers comp adjuster job postings as of February 2026
flag_reason: Shawna's title is Claims Manager — she may handle claims administration rather than vendor/record review decisions. Confirm she owns the record review workflow before sending, or identify the Head of Vendor Services at Intercare.
